register: Informal je/jij/jouw throughout (about 790 strings use je/jij/jouw, no u/uw addressed to the reader), which is the norm for Dutch consumer apps; 'je' is the default, 'jij'/'jou' only for emphasis; buttons and menu items use the infinitive (Opslaan, Site toevoegen, Markeren als gelezen), instructions in sentences use the je-imperative (Voer … in, Kies …), and any u/uw form addressed to the reader is flagged as register (the hour abbreviation '%d u geleden' is not a register problem).

terms.use: artikel (het artikel, de artikelen; dit artikel, elk artikel, een nieuw artikel, het nieuwe artikel; compounds artikellijst, artikeltitel, artikeltrainer, artikelweergave, topartikelen)
avoid: bericht / berichten (for a NewsBlur story; fine for a forum post or a message)
terms.note: artikel is used about 900 times. Both artikel and verhaal are neuter, so the switch only changes plurals and compounds; keep 'nieuws' where the English says news (nieuwslezer, Nieuwsstroom). Severity low, category terminology.

terms.use: site (de site, de sites); website where the English says website or in running prose
terms.note: Do not churn site/website in prose.

terms.use: feed (de feed, de feeds; feedlijst, feedtitel, RSS-feed, webfeed)

terms.use: Positive? = Weet je het zeker?; beats = wint van (>); (like wins) = (leuk wint); Insta-fetch = Direct ophalen (never Instagram); Stale = Inactief; Play Next / Play Last = Hierna afspelen / Als laatste afspelen; Short (card height) = Laag; Leave unread = Ongelezen laten; Brief (summary length) = Kort; On its way = Onderweg / Wordt geladen; Newer:/Older: (archive date filter, feed_options_popover.js) = Nieuwer dan:/Ouder dan: (each label sits above a date input and 1d/1w/1m/1y chips, so 'Nieuwer dan: 1w' reads as a bound; 'Na: 1w' does not); Unmute (a user, profile_badge_view.js) = Niet meer dempen (never Geluid inschakelen)
terms.note: Also avoid where it means this concept: Instagram.

terms.use: web '%(time)s geleden', iOS '%@ geleden', Android '%1$s geleden' wrap the server's bare units ('%(number)d dagen'); Dutch needs no case change, so the wrappers are fine. Compact forms: %d u geleden / %d min geleden / %d d geleden
avoid: plural noun in a one form (1 dagen geleden)
